# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read and follow [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical repository guidance before making changes.

For refactoring or migrating an existing ArcPy script, use [`../docs/case-studies.md`](../docs/case-studies.md) as concrete examples of the intended project evolution.

For adapting this starter to a real workflow, use [`../docs/customizing.md`](../docs/customizing.md).

Preserve ArcGIS Pro and Windows compatibility, keep ArcPy-specific behavior explicit, and do not add generic Python infrastructure unless it solves a concrete problem in the GIS workflow.
